use_case_summary: Penumbra builds a VS Code copilot extension focused on low-latency inline suggestions and longer streaming completions for multi-line code. Primary needs: sub-120ms median for single-line suggestions, robust streaming for larger completions, deterministic model/version pinning per extension release, and per-installation rate limits. Secondary: embeddings for fuzzy code search and reranking for telemetry-based suggestion ranking.
technical_requirements: Latency: target median 60-120ms for inline completions; tail <300ms. Throughput: peak ~12k requests/min across active users for beta (scale to 50k+). Streaming: need chunked streaming with restartable sessions and reliable KV cache reuse across sessions. Auth: OAuth for extension users, support for short-lived tokens and refresh rotation; per-install token mapping. Rate limits: per-installation and per-customer quotas, spike protection and graceful fallback to smaller pinned model. Model/versioning: must pin model per extension release, immutable rollout IDs, canary rollout for 5% installs. Security: SOC2+, SSO/SAML for enterprise accounts, KMS support for dedicated/private deployments, audit logs forwarded to SIEM. Observability: token-level latency/cost breakdown, per-route dashboards, tracing hooks for streaming performance. Integration asks: VS Code SDK hooks example, sample streaming client (TS) and guidance for offline fallback when network intermittent.
